objective: Design, formalize, and evaluate an optimal in-person multi-item shopping list and route navigation engine for Torob Physical Shopping Assistant (Kalam)
audience: Torob Hackathon Judges, Product Engineers, and Tehran In-Person Shoppers
scope: Tehran Torob in-person dataset and real-world urban shopping dynamics
constraints: Realistic indoor physical navigation without GPS in basements
Preserve Iranian payment options and hours of operation

acceptance.description: Rigorous mathematical formulation and heuristic algorithm with pseudo-code and complexity analysis
Empirical dataset validation on real product combinations, shop density, and price/travel trade-offs
Comprehensive 3-tier routing architecture and offline fallback strategy
acceptance.required_evidence_kind: spatial architecture documentation and wayfinding logic

acceptance.description: Complete UI/UX specification with ASCII wireframes and user flows
Security, antitrust compliance, and operational guardrail analysis

permitted_actions: write study documentation and architecture artifacts
